config.label: Path of the agent's Ed25519 private key (unencrypted PKCS#8 PEM)
config.description: Path of the agent's Ed25519 private key (unencrypted PKCS#8 PEM). Created on first use if the file does not exist.

config.label: Service origin
config.description: Service origin. Must be https (plain http is accepted only for localhost).

config.label: Optional attribution tag (1 to 32 characters from a-z, 0-9, _ and -) sent as ?ref= on the registration calls only
config.description: Optional attribution tag (1 to 32 characters from a-z, 0-9, _ and -) sent as ?ref= on the registration calls only. An invalid tag is ignored.
